title: Prove a marked-residual stock floor and bind its reflection escape
body:
In the declared whole-plane native, whole-plane ADDRESS, X-translation and Gaussian scalar bank-GL grammar, an exact marked-residual commutator proves native rank mass at least full data stock. Arbitrary dirty helpers restored to identity and endpoints in the same commuting algebra do not evade it. The typed half-chunk extension states its separate f≥2/query-alphabet boundary.

The package also supplies an actual unpaired orthogonal reflection outside this grammar. It commutes with the old full source, sends a one-mark residual to three marks, and has phase-correct conjugated arity-2f native recipes with explicit paid adapters. Cheap source-factory conjugation reduces retained progress by the same rank, so the escape does not give a favorable complete caller.

Written all-parameter proofs are separate from exact finite audits: literal Gaussian factors, all characters for f=1..5, all native supports for L=1..8, a complete 64×64 normalizer equality, query recipes and source-progress tradeoff. General bit-linear ADDRESS, arbitrary Pauli Z, noncommuting adapters and changed targets remain outside the floor. No new κ or physical supplier admission is claimed.

Only `research/marked-residual-reflection/` is added. Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/marked-residual-reflection
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/marked-residual-reflection --check-source-history
```
